description: Converts a voltage from one range into another; only the topmost patched input is used, and the rest are ignored

params.text: Chooses the range the output is written in: 1 is -5V to +5V, 2 is 0V to 5V, 3 is -10V to +10V, 4 is 0V to 10V

inputs.text: A signal here is taken as running -5V to +5V, and anything beyond that is clipped
A signal here is taken as running 0V to 5V, and anything beyond that is clipped
A signal here is taken as running 0V to 10V, and anything beyond that is clipped
A signal here is taken as a pitch; on setting 4 the octave is stripped off and the note within it is spread over 0V to 10V, and on the other settings the voltage passes through

notes: With every input unpatched the output holds the last voltage it produced.

inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
